summary: Path Preview Popup tested end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/public/paths/{id}/outline is correct for all 5 paths. Each lesson exposes only title, minutes, video and quiz booleans; counts and totals match; unknown id returns 404; no auth needed; no _id. Frontend: all 5 landing cards open the path-preview dialog with title, stats, modules, lesson titles, minutes and lock icons, and no lesson content. Dialog closes with Escape and with X. View pricing closes the dialog and scrolls #pricing into view. Logged-out Sign up -> /register sets pending_path. A new user registers, picks a different onboarding goal (soc-l1) and still lands on /app/paths/soc-l2; pending_path is cleared. Existing student: logged-out start -> register -> login link -> login lands on /app/paths/incident-response. Logged in: the button reads 'Open this path', pricing is hidden, footer says 'Pick up right where you left off.', and the button goes to /app/paths/soc-l1. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Product note, outside this feature: the new FREE user who landed on /app/paths/soc-l2 (paid tier per pricing: 'Free = SOC Fundamentals path') saw full lesson content and 'Mark as complete'. Paths are not plan-gated, so the popup's 'Sign up to start' with a paid path gives free access. Confirm this is intended.
takePendingCase prefers pending_path over pending_case and clears both. Fine, but a stale pending_path (under 1h) from an earlier click overrides a newer pending_case click.
PathPreview shows 'outline unavailable' when the fetch fails, but there is no retry button (minor).
